name: Womanizer
overview: Scripture teaches that lustful desires, such as those held by a womanizer, are sinful at their root, equating even looking with lust to committing adultery in the heart, as Jesus declares in Matthew 5:28. Believers are called to imitate God by pursuing holiness and purity (Ephesians 5:1) and to focus their minds on what is true, honest, just, pure, and lovely (Philippians 4:8). Living by faith, which is confidence in unseen realities (Hebrews 11:1), empowers Christians to overcome sinful desires and live in a manner pleasing to God.
